Photo textures of walls, from ambientCG (https://ambientcg.com), by Lennart Demes and contributors,
under CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain): https://docs.ambientcg.com/license/

Bricks101, Bricks059, Bricks105, Plaster001, Concrete034 (1K JPG). Changed for the simulator: the colour maps
scaled to a mean of mid grey per channel (detail maps, see the README), the OpenGL normal maps unchanged.
